description: Fires after prompts Turn 3 (Tue Oct 13 ~12:15 CT) and immediately before prompts Turn 4 (Tue 21:00 CT). SM-02 silently drifts the NASA 53207 irradiance cache (chart in the data folder stays at 4.2). The RL-01 stranger WhatsApp (Marcus) and RL-02 Tony Gmail inbound carriers are NOT injected here — they already exist as static records in mock_data/whatsapp-api/messages.csv::WMSG_030 and mock_data/gmail-api/messages.csv::MSG_030 respectively, with the correct carrier timestamps (Marcus 2026-10-14T14:30:00Z, Tony 2026-10-15T16:02:00Z).

mutations.description: Silently set Milwaukee 53207 irradiance cache return to 4.5 kWh/m^2/day (chart in the data folder remains 4.2).
mutations.derived_from: persona/TOOLS.md NASA connector + AGENTS.md cache-vs-chart convention
mutations.rationale: Solar sizing depends on irradiance. The cache drift creates a cross-modal contradiction the assistant must reconcile against the chart PNG (MG-04) on T3.
mutations.applies_via: Real applier batch-records path (_apply_batch_records -> _admin_patch direct), which patches apod/2026-10-12 by the store's registered primary key (date). VERIFIED applied (http 200, explanation 4.2 -> 4.5). NOTE: scripts/check_injection.py only exercises _resolve_target/_apply_admin_op, both of which gate on a row carrying an 'id'/'pk' column; the nasa apod table's primary key column is 'date' and environment/nasa-api/nasa_data.py::_coerce_apod strips any extra 'id' column, so the standalone checker reports SM-02 UNRESOLVED even though the real harness applies it. A mock_data-only fix is impossible here; a clean checker-green fix needs a one-line src change to _resolve_target/_patch_row to fall back to the store's registered primary key when 'id'/'pk' are absent.
